scholarships.name: German Studies Research Grant **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: The aim of the research grant is to fund and encourage young academics to study subjects relating to German affairs on a long-term basis.
scholarships.sourceQuote: The programme is aimed at qualified students, graduates and doctoral candidates from North America who are carrying out research projects on German cultural studies.
